summary: Iteration 9 tested the new global Google Maps Coordinate Input system. Backend: 4 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_map_coords.py cover Property CRUD with map_coords, empty-clear, site.map_coords persistence and contact.map_coords persistence — all pass. Regression: existing 29 tests (test_captcha.py + test_page_content.py) still pass. Frontend: MapCoordsField renders correctly on /sell (testId prefix sell_form-map-coords) with correct read-only prefix 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=', instructional help text, and live preview link. Admin Add-property modal renders property-address text field ABOVE property-map-coords, both with correct testids and preview URL. Admin Content > Contact page renders field-map_coords correctly. Public /contact iframe (contact-map-iframe) and contact-open-map href both start with 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=' — verified in both coords-set mode and fallback (site address) mode. Public /property/{id} 'View on Google Maps' button (detail-map-btn) uses coords URL when set and falls back to '<MAPS_BASE>+encoded address' when unset (previously used /maps/search/?api=1 pattern — bundle was stale, resolved after frontend restart).
action_items: Optional: consider updating the pre-existing /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (still uses stale pngrealty.pg credentials — not touched this run).
critical_code_review_comments: Bug found & fixed by testing agent: /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Content.jsx branding schema was MISSING the required { key: 'map_coords', type: 'mapcoords' } entry, so [data-testid=branding-map_coords] did not render even though the BrandingEditor supported the type. Added the schema entry (Office Google Maps coordinates) between 'address' and 'logo_url'. Verified end-to-end: saving via branding-save persists site.map_coords, and /contact iframe + open-map immediately use it.

Note: The frontend bundle was stale on first hit (still contained '/maps/search/?api=1&query=' from an older PropertyDetail/Contact revision). A supervisorctl restart of the frontend picked up the current source; if that occurs again, bounce the frontend service.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted a TEST_MAP_COORDS Property and a TEST_MAP_COORDS_None Property during backend tests. Temporarily set + cleared site.map_coords and contact.map_coords during UI verification (net-zero change).
context_for_next_testing_agent: MapCoordsField exposes testIds: {testId}, {testId}-prefix (read-only 'https://www.google.com/maps?q='), {testId}-input, {testId}-help, {testId}-preview (only when coords entered). Public forms use sell_form-map-coords. Admin property modal uses property-map-coords (with property-address text field above it — data-testid='property-address'). Admin Content > Branding & Site now correctly renders branding-map_coords; Admin Content > Contact page renders field-map_coords. Contact page priority: contact.map_coords > site.map_coords > site.address fallback (still using MAPS_BASE). Property detail 'View on Google Maps' testId=detail-map-btn. Backend Property model has map_coords: Optional[str]. If you touch frontend and don't see updates, `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` to bust the CRA bundle.
